name: William Appleton
description: A Franciscan friar serving as John of Gaunt's personal physician. Killed at the Tower on 14 June 1381 alongside Sudbury, Hales, and Legge -- targeted, like the Savoy's destruction, because of his connection to the absent and widely hated Gaunt rather than for any office of his own.
narrative_function: Shows the killings at the Tower extending to anyone closely tied to Gaunt, not only office-holders in their own right.
